lines.text: Did you know? Vert is Latin for turn.
Quick quiz! Which means apart plus turn?

words.ex: We converted the garage into a small office.
The driver reversed the car into the parking space.
The company diverted funds to its new product line.

publish.title: Vert root: convert, reverse and divert
publish.value: Vert comes from Latin "vertere" (to turn). Words: convert, reverse and divert. convert = con + vert; reverse = re + verse; divert = di + vert.
